topic: Final Sprint Master Plan: Deep Repo Backlog & Tech-Debt Sweep, Worktree/Branch Hygiene, Packaging Hermeticity, and Autonomous GitHub Observability Protocol for Developer Preview v0.29.0

inputs.claude: The findings of this deep sweep confirm that Synlynk has been operating under severe operational debt. Accumulating 135 worktrees is not merely a disk hygiene issue—it is the direct architectural cause of the recurring LIVE-16 and LIVE-30 crash-loops...
inputs.agy: From a product and onboarding standpoint, shipping a developer preview with 85+ dead worktrees/job-* folders and operational files at the repository root destroys credibility...
inputs.codex: The mechanical root cause of instability across past releases is the interplay between editable installs and short-lived git worktrees. When Worktree Hygiene prunes a worktree, any background process holding a reference to that worktree dies on ModuleNotFoundError...
inputs.grok: This final sprint cements the operational transition to Paradigm 2a while laying the cryptographic bedrock for Paradigm 2b: Sovereign Key Infrastructure, Fenced Companion, and GitHub-native telemetry rollups...

synthesis: The panel unanimously approves the Final Sprint Master Plan across 4 phases: Deep Repo & Worktree Housekeeping, Core Engine Hermeticity & Test Green, Unified Genesis Onboarding & Sovereign Key, and Developer Preview Gate Closeout.
decision: Execute the Final Sprint Master Plan immediately under the governance of parent issue #5163, with GitHub as the sole observability and approval surface.
